title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 5,901–5,950 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 現代國際綜合物流供應鏈管理

examples.en: Smart freight logistics relies on real-time GPS tracking and automated warehousing to speed up shipping.
examples.zh: 智慧貨運物流高度仰賴 GPS 即時追蹤與自動化立體倉儲，全面加速跨國運輸配送。

examples.en: She managed the regional logistics network, coordinating hundreds of daily truck departures.
examples.zh: 她負責掌管區域綜合物流調度網絡，統籌每天數百班長途貨運卡車的準點發車作業。

examples.en: Disruptions in global logistics during typhoons can delay manufacturing across several continents.
examples.zh: 颱風季節引發的全球物流鏈受阻，可能會導致橫跨數大洲的尖端科技製造業面臨缺料停工。

words.definition: 全球高韌性端對端供應鏈；供應鏈

examples.en: Diversifying suppliers across Southeast Asia strengthens corporate supply chain resilience against disruptions.
examples.zh: 在東南亞多國佈局多元供應商，能大幅強化企業供應鏈抵禦斷鏈危機的韌性。

examples.en: Shortages of semiconductor chips paralyzed the entire automotive supply chain for nearly two years.
examples.zh: 先進半導體車用晶片的全球大缺貨，曾讓全球汽車供應鏈陷入長達近兩年的嚴重減產停滯。

examples.en: Companies audit tiers of their supply chain to guarantee ethical sourcing of raw minerals.
examples.zh: 跨國品牌全面稽核其深層多級供應鏈廠商，以確保各項關鍵工業礦產皆來自合規道德產地。

words.definition: 二十呎與四十呎標準海運貨櫃；容器

examples.en: Standardized steel intermodal shipping containers revolutionized global trade by slashing unloading times.
examples.zh: 標準化鋼製海運貨櫃，大幅縮短了碼頭裝卸時間，徹底掀起全球貿易革命。

examples.en: Over twenty thousand metal containers were stacked on the open deck of the freighter.
examples.zh: 超過兩萬只彩色鋼製貨櫃整齊碼放在這艘巨型遠洋貨輪的開闊甲板上。

examples.en: Customs officials selected thirty import containers for thorough X-ray contraband inspection.
examples.zh: 海關查緝關員抽點了三十只特定進口貨櫃，引導進入高能 X 光大型貨櫃檢驗儀進行掃描查驗。

words.definition: 二十呎標準貨櫃計算單位 (TEU)；單位

examples.en: Megaships carry over twenty-four thousand twenty-foot equivalent units (TEU) in a single ocean voyage.
examples.zh: 全球最新超大型巨輪單趟遠洋航程，即可裝載超過兩萬四千個二十呎標準貨櫃單位。

examples.en: Port statistics count annual capacity in TEU units to benchmark international shipping efficiency.
examples.zh: 國際各大港口皆以標準 TEU 貨櫃計量單位統計全年吞吐量，以客觀評定全球港務營運效率。

examples.en: A standard forty-foot container represents two equivalent TEU units in commercial maritime accounting.
examples.zh: 在國際海運商業核算標準中，一只四十呎大櫃在計量上等同於兩個標準二十呎 TEU 單位。

words.definition: 兩萬四千 TEU 超大型巨型貨櫃輪；船艦

examples.en: The colossal container vessel navigated through the narrow harbor entrance guided by four tugboats.
examples.zh: 在四艘大馬力拖船引領下，這艘載滿貨櫃的巨型貨櫃輪緩緩駛入狹窄的港灣航道。

examples.en: Specialized deepwater dredgers cleared mud channels so the fully loaded vessel could dock safely.
examples.zh: 港務專用深水挖泥船疏浚清除了主航道沉積淤泥，確保滿載貨物的巨輪能夠安全靠泊深水碼頭。

examples.en: The maritime company commissioned three new green-methanol container vessels from local shipyards.
examples.zh: 該國際航運巨頭向本土造船廠正式下單訂造三艘採用綠色甲醇動力的次世代環保貨櫃輪。

words.definition: 國際海事海運法規與綠色航運的

examples.en: Strict international maritime regulations mandate the adoption of low-sulfur fuels across global waters.
examples.zh: 嚴格的國際海事法規，強制要求行駛於公海的遠洋貨輪改用超低硫燃油。

examples.en: Taiwan holds an indispensable position within Indo-Pacific maritime commercial transit corridors.
examples.zh: 台灣在整個印太地區的海事商業航運過境走廊中，佔據著不可替代的核心關鍵樞紐地位。

examples.en: Graduates from the maritime university secure rewarding careers navigating ocean-going container fleets.
examples.zh: 國立海洋大學航海系優秀畢業生，紛紛投入遠洋貨櫃商船船隊展開待遇優渥的跑船職涯。

words.definition: 高雄港第七貨櫃智慧全自動化碼頭；港口

examples.en: The Port of Kaohsiung operates state-of-the-art automated terminals handling millions of transshipments yearly.
examples.zh: 高雄港營運全球頂尖全自動化貨櫃碼頭，每年高效處理數百萬轉口貨櫃。

examples.en: Dense road and rail links connect the deepwater commercial port to inland industrial manufacturing zones.
examples.zh: 密集的高速公路與鐵路專用支線，將深水商港與內陸科技製造園區緊密串聯在一起。

examples.en: Ships from sixty countries call at the busy international container port every week.
examples.zh: 每個星期有來自全球超過六十個國家的各型商船，頻繁靠泊這座繁忙的世界級貨櫃港。

words.definition: 水深十八米深水重載碼頭岸壁；碼頭

examples.en: Giant STS gantry cranes line the concrete deepwater quay ready to unload arriving mega-vessels.
examples.zh: 巍峨的超大型岸邊橋式起重機在深水碼頭岸壁上整齊排列，準備為抵港巨輪卸載貨櫃。

examples.en: Forklifts and yard trucks moved rhythmically along the bustling commercial wharf quay.
examples.zh: 堆高機與港區牽引車在繁忙喧囂的碼頭岸壁作業區上，宛如精密發條般規律流暢穿梭穿梭。

examples.en: Reinforcing the reinforced concrete quay allows it to bear the extreme weight of modern shore cranes.
examples.zh: 全面加固鋼筋混凝土深水碼頭岸壁基樁，能使其穩穩承受現代巨型岸邊橋吊的極限垂直重壓。

words.definition: 貨櫃輪專用靠泊船位泊位；停泊

examples.en: The harbor master assigned the flagship freighter to an open deepwater berth with twenty-four-hour crane operations.
examples.zh: 港務長將旗艦貨輪調度至具備二十四小時全天候起重機作業的專用深水泊位。

examples.en: Ships wait at anchorage offshore until an assigned container berth clears of previous traffic.
examples.zh: 入港貨櫃船在港外錨地依序下錨排隊，耐心等候指定碼頭泊位前一艘卸貨船舶出港清空。

examples.en: Harbor pilots expertly maneuvered the massive bulk carrier into its assigned waterfront berth.
examples.zh: 資深引水人展現純熟精湛的操船技術，將龐大的散裝貨輪穩穩引導停靠至指定的靠泊泊位。

words.definition: 雙吊具遠端遙控岸邊橋式起重機 (STS)

examples.en: Remote-controlled ship-to-shore gantry cranes lift two forty-foot containers simultaneously with laser precision.
examples.zh: 遠端操作的岸邊門式橋式起重機，能以雷射對位同時吊起兩只四十呎重型貨櫃。

examples.en: High-speed gantry cranes straddle multiple rail tracks to rapidly transfer boxes onto waiting trains.
examples.zh: 高速軌道式門式起重機大跨距橫跨多條鐵軌，在數分鐘內將貨櫃迅速吊裝上待命的火車平板車。

examples.en: The crane operator sat in an ergonomic air-conditioned control center steering the giant gantry via joysticks.
examples.zh: 起重機操控員端坐在遠端恆溫控制室中，藉由高靈敏操控桿舒適精準地指揮巨型橋式起重機。

words.definition: 軌道式全自動門式防搖起重機的

examples.en: Rail-mounted automated cranes stack incoming containers in precise rows without human cab operators.
examples.zh: 軌道式全自動起重機無需駕駛員坐鎮，即可在堆場將卸下的貨櫃精準碼放整齊。

examples.en: The new terminal boasts fully automated gates equipped with high-speed optical camera scanners.
examples.zh: 全新智慧貨櫃碼頭全面啟用全自動感應管制閘口，搭載高速光學攝影辨識相機。

examples.en: Automated stacking yards reduce labor injuries while delivering round-the-clock operating consistency.
examples.zh: 全自動化無人貨櫃堆場不僅大幅杜絕了碼頭工安職災風險，更實現了全天候不間斷的超高裝卸效能。

words.definition: 5G 智慧無人搬運自動導引車 (AGV)；引導

examples.en: Automated guided vehicles (AGVs) transport heavy containers quietly between the quay and storage yards.
examples.zh: 全電動無人自動導引搬運車，安靜無聲穿梭於碼頭與堆場之間。

examples.en: Buried transponders and magnetic floor markers guide driverless transport vehicles along harbor tracks.
examples.zh: 預先埋設於地面下的射頻發報晶片與磁性感應標記，引導無人搬運車沿著專屬安全路線行駛。

examples.en: The port management software guides crane operators to pick the exact container scheduled for export.
examples.zh: 智慧碼頭作業軟體自動引導起重機吊具，分秒不差鎖定並吊取排定出口的目標貨櫃。

words.definition: 5G 毫米波碼頭全自動無人駕駛搬運的

examples.en: Fleet management algorithms orchestrate dozens of autonomous electric trucks across the smart terminal.
examples.zh: 智慧調度演算法指揮著數十輛自動駕駛電動卡車，在智慧港區內井然有序穿梭運輸。

examples.en: Sensor-laden autonomous shuttle carriers navigate around corners while avoiding stationary equipment.
examples.zh: 搭載高精度光達感測器的自走式無人跨載機，能靈敏轉向閃避盲點並主動繞行靜止障礙設備。

examples.en: Transitioning to autonomous harbor logistics lowers diesel fuel emissions and boosts turnaround speed.
examples.zh: 全面轉型導入全自動無人碼頭物流作業，能顯著消除柴油黑煙排放並成倍縮短靠泊周轉時間。

words.definition: 貨櫃堆場智慧堆疊與翻櫃最小化；場地

examples.en: Smart terminal operating software organizes the container yard to minimize unnecessary box reshuffling.
examples.zh: 智慧碼頭作業系統對貨櫃堆場進行動態空間最佳化，將不必要的翻櫃次數降至最低。

examples.en: Semi-trucks lined up outside the terminal gates waiting to drop off exports in the container yard.
examples.zh: 長途拖車在碼頭大門外排成一條長龍，依序等待進入管制堆場卸放即將報關出口的重櫃。

examples.en: Floodlights illuminate the sprawling container yard, enabling non-stop overnight cargo transfers.
examples.zh: 高空大功率投光燈將廣袤無邊的貨櫃堆場照耀得如白晝，保障通宵達旦的裝卸作業安全運作。

words.definition: 六層高密度自動化精準貨櫃堆疊

examples.en: Automated stacking systems pack containers six tiers high to maximize limited waterfront real estate.
examples.zh: 全自動高密度堆疊系統，將貨櫃整齊向上堆疊至六層樓高，極致利用寸土寸金的港區土地。

examples.en: Wind warning sensors limit high-tier empty container stacking during coastal typhoon alerts.
examples.zh: 陣風預警超音波風速計在颱風警報發布時，會強制啟動安全防風協議，限制空櫃堆疊高度。

examples.en: Sophisticated stacking logic ensures that containers leaving first are always placed on top.
examples.zh: 精密的堆垛邏輯演算法能確保預定最先裝船出港的貨櫃永遠碼放在最上層，免除繁瑣翻櫃。

words.definition: 全年數千萬 TEU 貨櫃吞吐量；產出量

examples.en: Upgrading terminal automation boosted annual container throughput by twenty-five percent.
examples.zh: 引進先進全自動化裝卸設備後，該國際樞紐港的全年貨櫃吞吐量大幅躍升兩成五。

examples.en: The bustling Asian port achieved a historic record throughput of twenty million shipping containers.
examples.zh: 這座繁忙的亞洲指標性港口創下歷史新高，全年貨櫃總吞吐量強勢衝破兩千萬個標準貨櫃大關。

examples.en: Enhancing customs clearance software increased truck gate throughput to six hundred vehicles per hour.
examples.zh: 升級智慧海關自動放行軟體，使卡車檢查哨出入閘口的車流通行吞吐量達到每小時六百輛次。

words.definition: 海陸空海鐵海空多式聯運無縫轉運的

examples.en: Intermodal freight networks transfer shipping containers directly from cargo ships onto freight trains.
examples.zh: 多式聯運網絡，能將進口海運貨櫃無縫直接吊裝上火車貨運列車奔馳內陸。

examples.en: Using standardized intermodal containers eliminates the need to unpack goods when switching vehicles.
examples.zh: 採用標準規格的海陸空多式聯運貨櫃，在輪船、火車與卡車轉換交接時完全無需開箱重裝。

examples.en: The inland intermodal rail terminal handles hundreds of imported shipping containers every evening.
examples.zh: 這座內陸海鐵聯運鐵路貨運轉運站，每天傍晚高效處理從沿海港口鐵路專線抵達的數百只海運貨櫃。

words.definition: 智慧無紙化二十四小時快速海關通關

examples.en: Paperless electronic customs declarations clear compliant import cargo within minutes of ship arrival.
examples.zh: 採用無紙化智慧海關申報，在貨輪靠泊後數分鐘內即可完成合規貨物線上放行。

examples.en: High-risk shipments flagged by automated risk algorithms are diverted to customs inspection bays.
examples.zh: 被智慧風險評估演算法列為高風險的貨櫃，會被自動導引至海關專用人工開箱查驗區。

examples.en: Customs brokers assist importers by classifying tariff codes and ensuring trade compliance.
examples.zh: 專業報關行全力協助進口廠商精確申報貨品稅則號列，並確保百分之百符合各項貿易法規。

words.definition: 電子海關艙單與提單申報 (EDI)；清單

examples.en: Shipping lines must transmit the electronic cargo manifest to customs twenty-four hours before loading.
examples.zh: 國際海運航商必須在貨物裝船前二十四小時，向海關系統傳輸完整的電子貨物艙單。

examples.en: Discrepancies between the physical cargo and the documented shipping manifest trigger fines.
examples.zh: 實體開箱查驗若發現現場貨物與申報艙單文件內容不符，將面臨海關嚴厲裁罰甚至扣貨調查。

examples.en: The master verified the dangerous goods manifest before authorizing hazardous chemicals onboard.
examples.zh: 船長在親筆核准危險化學品裝船起運前，慎重核對了專用危險品貨物申報艙單的每一項細節。

words.definition: 國際海運提單物權所有權憑證 (B/L)

examples.en: The original ocean bill of lading serves as a definitive title document proving cargo ownership.
examples.zh: 正本海運提單，是國際貿易中代表貨物物權、不可或缺的法定所有權憑證。

examples.en: Banks release letter of credit financing only after inspecting an unendorsed clean bill of lading.
examples.zh: 押匯銀行唯有在嚴格審核無瑕疵的清潔海運提單正本後，方始依約撥付信用狀款項。

examples.en: Modern digital bills of lading use cryptographic tokens to replace vulnerable paper documents.
examples.zh: 現代區塊鏈數位電子提單採用高強度加密憑證技術，全面取代易遭仿冒與遺失的傳統紙本單據。

words.definition: 貨櫃逾期未提之碼頭滯留費與延滯費

examples.en: Importers incur heavy demurrage penalties if containers sit in the port terminal past the free-time window.
examples.zh: 若進口商在免費提領期限過後仍未將貨櫃提走，將被港務當局課徵高昂的逾期滯留費。

examples.en: Port congestion during the holiday rush caused skyrocketing demurrage costs for retail importers.
examples.zh: 歐美年底購物旺季期間碼頭塞港癱瘓，導致大型零售進口商背負飆升上億的貨櫃超期滯留罰金。

examples.en: To avoid mounting demurrage fees, the distributor hired extra third-party truckers to evacuate boxes.
examples.zh: 為了徹底止血不斷累積的巨額延滯費用，經銷商緊急加價僱用外部第三方卡車車隊漏夜提領疏運。

words.definition: 貨櫃海運即時運價指數 (SCFI 指數)；貨運

examples.en: Global freight indices fluctuate according to fuel costs, geopolitical tensions, and consumer demand.
examples.zh: 全球海運貨運運價指數，隨著國際油價、地緣政治衝突與消費市場需求劇烈波動。

examples.en: The corporation locks in multi-year ocean freight contracts to stabilize shipping budgets.
examples.zh: 跨國製造業巨頭透過與海運航商簽署多年期長約鎖定優惠運價，以穩定集團年度運輸預算。

examples.en: Air freight charges are calculated based on whichever is greater: actual weight or volumetric size.
examples.zh: 國際航空貨運運費核算標準，依據實際毛重與材積重量兩者中數值較大者進行計價收取。

words.definition: 國際海空運貨運承攬業者 (攬貨商)

examples.en: Freight forwarders negotiate shipping space, arrange insurance, and handle overseas trucking logistics.
examples.zh: 專業國際貨運承攬業者，為進出口廠商代訂海空運艙位並安排跨境卡車報關。

examples.en: An experienced freight forwarder can find alternate air routes when sea ports are strike-bound.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的貨代攬貨業者在海運港口遭遇罷工癱瘓時，能以最快速度規劃出替代航空應急專案。

examples.en: Selecting a forwarder with established customs networks speeds up border clearance for exporters.
examples.zh: 挑選在目的港擁有成熟深厚海關人脈網絡的頂級承攬商，能為出口商大幅加速跨國邊境通關放行。

words.definition: 散貨拼箱與拆箱集運 (LCL 集併)

examples.en: Less-than-container-load (LCL) consolidation combines goods from multiple small businesses into one container.
examples.zh: 散貨拼箱集運，將多家中小企業的少量貨物整合成一個完整貨櫃以節省跨國運費。

examples.en: The warehouse performs deconsolidation, sorting incoming pallet shipments for domestic courier delivery.
examples.zh: 物流集運保稅倉庫負責執行拆箱作業，將到港的散裝棧板貨品依收件地址分流至國內宅配車隊。

examples.en: Cargo consolidation maximizes container cubic volume, preventing companies from paying for empty air.
examples.zh: 專業散裝拼箱集運技術能將貨櫃容積利用率發揮至極致，杜絕企業為浪費的貨櫃空間支付冤枉錢。

words.definition: 恆溫插電冷凍冷藏貨櫃 (溫控箱)

examples.en: Plugging high-tech reefer containers into terminal power outlets keeps premium beef frozen at minus twenty.
examples.zh: 將高科技冷凍冷藏貨櫃插上碼頭專用受電插座，能讓頂級冷鮮牛肉在零下二十度維持冰封。

examples.en: Reefer vessels are fitted with dedicated backup generators to power thousands of refrigerated units.
examples.zh: 現代全冷凍冷藏貨櫃輪搭載專用的大功率備用柴油發電機組，為航行中的數千只冷凍箱全天候供電。

examples.en: Technicians inspect the cooling compressor of each reefer before loading sensitive produce.
examples.zh: 專業冷凍電機技師在裝載嬌嫩鮮果之前，會逐一檢測每只冷凍貨櫃的壓縮機運轉效能與風道循環。

words.definition: 零下八十度不斷鏈疫苗與生鮮冷鏈物流

examples.en: Maintaining an unbroken cold chain preserves temperature-sensitive vaccines during trans-Pacific flight.
examples.zh: 全程維持不斷鏈的專業冷鏈物流，能確保跨越太平洋空運的生物疫苗品質萬無一失。

examples.en: Any temperature excursion along the cold chain can cause expensive pharmaceutical batches to spoil.
examples.zh: 冷鏈物流運輸途中的任何微小溫度脫軌飆升，都會直接導致價值連城的百萬生技藥品整批報廢。

examples.en: Supermarket chains invest heavily in advanced cold chain infrastructure to ensure seafood freshness.
examples.zh: 跨國大型超級市場集團重金投資最尖端低溫冷鏈物流設施，確保遠洋生猛海鮮的極致新鮮口感。

words.definition: 恆溫正負 0.5 度精密溫控與即時記錄

examples.en: Precision temperature dataloggers monitor thermal stability inside pharmaceutical containers continuously.
examples.zh: 高精密溫度記錄儀，全程二十四小時持續監控藥品冷藏箱內的恆溫狀態。

examples.en: The dairy shipment must be maintained at a stable temperature between two and four degrees Celsius.
examples.zh: 這批高優質鮮乳在跨國配送途中，全程環境溫度必須嚴格維持在攝氏兩度至四度的黃金溫層。

examples.en: Digital sensors trigger automatic alerts if the container’s internal temperature rises by even one degree.
examples.zh: 數位感測系統在貨櫃內部溫度哪怕僅微幅攀升攝氏一度時，也會立即向後台調度中心發出自動警報。

words.definition: IoT 衛星即時貨櫃溫濕度遠端監控數據

examples.en: Cellular and satellite telemetry alerts the fleet manager instantly if a refrigeration compressor malfunctions.
examples.zh: 結合蜂巢網路與衛星遠端遙測技術，在冷凍壓縮機出現異常跳脫時即刻發出警報。

examples.en: Continuous location telemetry allows cargo owners to track high-value semiconductor shipments in real time.
examples.zh: 全天候無間斷的衛星定位遠端遙測系統，讓高科技晶圓大廠隨時能在手機上精確掌握億元晶圓動態。

examples.en: Solar-powered telemetry devices mounted on container doors detect any unauthorized physical opening.
examples.zh: 安裝於貨櫃防盜門鎖扣上的太陽能微型遙測發報模組，能在門扉遭受非法撬開時瞬間發送通報。

words.definition: 台灣金鑽鳳梨與愛文芒果等生鮮易腐的

examples.en: Exporting delicate perishable tropical fruits requires rapid customs clearance and cold warehousing.
examples.zh: 外銷台灣頂級易腐生鮮蔬果，仰賴綠色通道快速報關與低溫保鮮冷鏈倉儲。

examples.en: Highly perishable seafood shipments are prioritized for early discharge upon docking.
examples.zh: 具備高時效性與易腐特性的高價遠洋黑鮪魚海鮮漁獲，在貨輪靠泊時享有優先進港卸貨的綠色特權。

examples.en: Dedicated express cargo flights transport sensitive perishables directly to premium Asian grocery markets.
examples.zh: 專線直飛的全貨運包機將這批極易變質的珍稀生鮮農特產，直送東京與首爾頂級精品超市搶鮮上架。

words.definition: 氣調保鮮貨櫃 (CA 降氧延緩水果熟成)

examples.en: Controlled atmosphere containers lower oxygen levels to put exported fresh apples into a dormant sleep.
examples.zh: 採用氣調保鮮技術，調降貨櫃內氧氣濃度讓出口水果進入冬眠延長保鮮期。

examples.en: Injecting nitrogen gas creates a low-oxygen atmosphere that arrests fruit ripening during long ocean voyages.
examples.zh: 在冷藏貨櫃內部精準注入惰性氮氣營造低氧微氣候，能在跨洋長途航行中徹底凍結水果熟化進程。

examples.en: Maintaining a controlled atmosphere triples the shelf life of green bananas shipped across oceans.
examples.zh: 恆定維持的氣調保鮮微氣候環境，能讓橫渡大洋運送的綠香蕉保鮮貨架期整整延長三倍之久。

words.definition: ISO 標準化堆高機專用防滑塑膠棧板

examples.en: Heavy cardboard boxes are shrink-wrapped tightly onto plastic pallets for safe forklift loading.
examples.zh: 將成箱貨物整齊碼放並用熱縮膜緊緊包覆在防滑塑膠棧板上，方便堆高機叉取吊裝。

examples.en: Wooden pallets must undergo heat treatment and stamp certification to prevent beetle infestations across borders.
examples.zh: 跨國流通的木質棧板必須經過高溫熱處理燻蒸並加蓋 IPPC 國際認證鋼印，以防天牛蛀蟲跨海蔓延。

examples.en: Automated conveyor belts transfer loaded wooden pallets straight into high-bay storage racks.
examples.zh: 自動化重型滾筒輸送帶將整盤碼放整齊的木棧板貨物，平穩直送立體高架倉儲貨架中存放。

words.definition: 鋰電池零排放高效電動堆高機；叉運

examples.en: Electric forklifts maneuver swiftly through narrow warehouse aisles loading pallets onto waiting semi-trucks.
examples.zh: 零廢氣排放的電動堆高機，在狹窄的倉庫貨架走道間靈巧穿梭，將貨物裝上大卡車。

examples.en: Drivers must earn specialized certification before legally operating heavy industrial forklifts.
examples.zh: 現場操作人員依法必須考取國家級專業重機械技術士證照，方得合法駕駛大型重型堆高機。

examples.en: The forklift operator lowered the hydraulic mast gently to rest the heavy machinery crate onto the deck.
examples.zh: 堆高機駕駛員平穩柔和地降下液壓起重門架，將重達兩噸的精密機械木箱妥貼安放在卡車平板上。

words.definition: 二十五米高架立體自動化倉儲重型貨架

examples.en: Heavy-duty steel racking reaches the warehouse ceiling, quadrupling pallet storage density per square meter.
examples.zh: 拔地而起高達二十五公尺的重型鋼製立體貨架，將每平方公尺的棧板倉儲容積放大四倍。

examples.en: Seismic safety inspections check whether tall storage racking can withstand sudden earthquake shaking.
examples.zh: 港區結構技師定期進行嚴苛的抗震安全檢測，確保超高立體倉儲貨架能抵禦強烈地震劇烈搖晃。

examples.en: Drive-in pallet racking systems maximize floor area by eliminating empty access aisles between lanes.
examples.zh: 貫通式車入棧板重型貨架系統徹底消除了貨架間多餘的通道，將倉儲空間利用率推升至極限境界。

words.definition: 自動化立體倉儲存取系統 (AS/RS)；取回

examples.en: Automated storage and retrieval systems (AS/RS) fetch requested stock parts in under forty seconds.
examples.zh: 自動化立體倉儲存取系統，能在四十秒內精準定位並自動取出產線所需的零組件。

examples.en: Computer algorithms prioritize fast-moving inventory close to retrieval bays to boost fulfillment speed.
examples.zh: 智慧倉儲演算法自動將高周轉率熱銷商品安排在靠近出庫口之低樓層，極大化出貨揀貨效率。

examples.en: Robotic cranes execute seamless item retrieval without any human climbing required.
examples.zh: 軌道式無人堆垛機全自動執行精準貨物抓取存取，完全無需任何倉管人員冒險登高攀爬貨架。

words.definition: 每小時數萬件高速自動分揀輸送帶

examples.en: High-speed parcel sorting conveyor systems scan barcodes and divert packages into specific regional chutes.
examples.zh: 每小時處理數萬件包裹的高速分揀輸送帶，自動掃描條碼並將包裹精準滑入各行政區滑道。

examples.en: The quiet motorized roller conveyor shuttles heavy cardboard boxes between assembly lines and loading docks.
examples.zh: 靜音微型無刷電動滾筒輸送機在組裝流水線與裝卸貨碼頭之間，高速穿梭輸送沉重的瓦楞紙箱。

examples.en: An overhead belt conveyor carries empty packaging supplies directly above picker workstations.
examples.zh: 高空吊掛懸空輸送帶在揀貨員頭頂無聲運轉，源源不絕將空包裝箱精準送達各揀貨包裝工作站。

words.definition: RFID 無線射頻與二維條碼貨物追蹤；條碼

examples.en: Handheld wireless barcode scanners update package tracking information instantly onto the consumer app.
examples.zh: 手持式無線條碼掃描槍，在貨物出庫刷條碼瞬間將包裹動態同步至客戶手機。

examples.en: Laser scanners read the two-dimensional barcode at a speed of five hundred items per minute.
examples.zh: 頂級全向雷射掃描機以每分鐘五百件的驚人速度，瞬間捕捉掃描高速掠過包裹上的二維條碼。

examples.en: A damaged, unreadable barcode on the carton required manual lookup by warehouse staff.
examples.zh: 瓦楞外箱上被磨損模糊的條碼標籤無法被機器識別，需由物流主管手動輸入快遞單號進行查核。

words.definition: AI 演算法智慧最佳化車隊排程派工；派遣

examples.en: Intelligent dispatch algorithms calculate optimal delivery routes to avoid downtown gridlock traffic.
examples.zh: 智慧派工調度系統，利用演算法為貨運車隊即時規劃最佳配送路徑以避開市區塞車。

examples.en: The fleet manager pressed the dispatch button to release fifty delivery vans into morning traffic.
examples.zh: 車隊營運總監按下一鍵派工調度確認鍵，排程出發的五十輛宅配物流車隨即井然有序開入早晨車流。

examples.en: Real-time traffic alerts fed directly into the automated dispatch system to dynamically reroute delivery vans.
examples.zh: 即時路況事故通報數據直接回傳串接至自動派工系統，第一時間為在途物流車智慧重新規劃最佳避堵路徑。

words.definition: 綠能電動車最後一哩路配送到家的

examples.en: Zero-emission electric vans and cargo bikes handle last-mile delivery to neighborhood residential doors.
examples.zh: 採用純電廂型車與電動三輪貨車執行最後一哩路配送，實現純淨零碳送貨到府。

examples.en: Solving high labor costs in last-mile logistics represents the biggest hurdle for e-commerce profitability.
examples.zh: 克服最後一哩路末端配送的高昂人力成本與停車瓶頸，是當今大型電商平台能否轉虧為盈的最大關鍵。

examples.en: Urban micro-fulfillment centers enable same-day last-mile package delivery across crowded metropolises.
examples.zh: 深入市區巷弄的都會微型智慧物流倉，讓人口稠密的大都會區能夠輕鬆實現當日下單兩小時極速送達。

words.definition: 桃園國際機場亞太航空貨運物流樞紐

examples.en: Taoyuan International Airport functions as a crucial air freight transshipment hub connecting Asia to America.
examples.zh: 桃園國際機場作為亞太地區不可或缺的航空貨運物流樞紐，串聯亞洲與美洲製造動脈。

examples.en: Global logistics firms build automated distribution hubs adjacent to major highway interchanges.
examples.zh: 跨國物流巨擘紛紛在重要國道高速公路交流道旁，重金圈地興建大型全自動化區域智慧轉運樞紐。

examples.en: Diverting parcel volume through regional consolidation hubs keeps long-haul trucks filled to capacity.
examples.zh: 透過區域中繼集運轉運樞紐進行貨量收整集併，能確保每輛跨縣市長途幹線大貨車均能維持百分之百滿載。

words.definition: 蘇伊士運河與巴拿馬運河關鍵海運要衝

examples.en: Transiting the Panama Canal saves container freighters thousands of nautical miles around South America.
examples.zh: 穿越百年巴拿馬運河，為跨洋貨輪節省了繞道南美洲合恩角數千海里的航程與油耗。

examples.en: Grounding a giant megaship in the Suez Canal halted ten billion dollars in global trade every single day.
examples.zh: 超級巨輪長賜輪在蘇伊士運河意外擱淺卡死，曾造成全球每天高達上百億美元國際貿易瞬間停擺癱瘓。

examples.en: Expansion of the canal locks allows larger Neo-Panamax vessels to pass with heavier cargo loads.
examples.zh: 運河全新拓寬擴建水閘工程竣工後，允許吃水更深、載貨量更龐大的新巴拿馬型巨輪安全快速通航。

words.definition: 麻六甲海峽與台灣海峽國際海運咽喉

examples.en: The Taiwan Strait serves as a vital international shipping strait carrying half of global container traffic.
examples.zh: 台灣海峽是全球海運最繁忙的關鍵國際海峽咽喉，承載全球近半數貨櫃船通行。

examples.en: Heavy naval and commercial traffic chokes the narrow waters of the Malacca Strait every day.
examples.zh: 麻六甲海峽狹窄逼仄的水道之中，每天承載著川流不息、密密麻麻的各國軍艦與大型商船航行。

examples.en: Freedom of navigation through this strategic strait is essential to maintain unbroken worldwide trade.
examples.zh: 確保這條戰略海峽咽喉公海水域的航行自由與航行安全，是維繫全球貿易生命線順暢運轉的絕對前提。

words.definition: 綠色甲醇與生質柴油船舶航運脫碳轉型

examples.en: Maritime decarbonization accelerates as global shipping lines order green methanol dual-fuel container vessels.
examples.zh: 隨著全球各大航商大批訂購綠色甲醇雙燃料貨輪，國際海運脫碳淨零轉型全面加速。

examples.en: Installing wind-assisted rotor sails on cargo ships contributes to fleetwide decarbonization goals.
examples.zh: 在遠洋散裝貨輪甲板上加裝旋翼風帆輔助推進系統，為達成船隊整體脫碳減排目標貢獻具體成果。

examples.en: The United Nations set ambitious 2050 targets for complete maritime shipping decarbonization.
examples.zh: 聯合國國際海事組織針對全球國際海運業，制定了於西元二零五零年實現航運完全脫碳的雄偉藍圖。

words.definition: 碼頭高壓岸電系統 (停泊熄火零空污)

examples.en: Plugging berthed ships into high-voltage shore-power allows onboard diesel engines to shut down completely.
examples.zh: 靠泊貨輪插上碼頭高壓岸電系統，能讓船上柴油副發電機完全熄火，杜絕港區空污。

examples.en: Port authorities invest in heavy electrical substations to deliver megawatt shore-power to cruise ships.
examples.zh: 國際港務當局斥資興建大型高壓變電所，為靠港的巨型萬人郵輪提供數兆瓦的高壓岸電直供。

examples.en: Mandatory shore-power regulations eliminate harbor air pollution, improving lung health for port cities.
examples.zh: 港口強制實施靠泊接駁岸電法規，能徹底消除柴油黑煙與硫化物空污，守護港灣周邊城市居民呼吸道健康。

words.definition: 區塊鏈全程不可篡改供應鏈產銷履歷

examples.en: End-to-end blockchain supply chain traceability verifies that timber and coffee were ethically sourced.
examples.zh: 導入區塊鏈端對端產銷溯源系統，能百分之百驗證原木與咖啡豆來自合規永續產地。

examples.en: Food safety laws mandate item-level traceability for imported frozen poultry and seafood.
examples.zh: 現代食品安全衛生管理法規明確規範，所有進口冷凍水產與禽肉皆必須具備精確到單箱的嚴密產銷履歷。

examples.en: Enhanced digital traceability enables pharmaceutical brands to recall contaminated pill batches within minutes.
examples.zh: 全面升級的數位產銷溯源網絡，能協助跨國製藥大廠在數分鐘內精準鎖定並召回受污染批次的瑕疵藥品。

words.definition: 船舶快速靠泊裝卸周轉超高營運效率

examples.en: Fully automated container terminals achieve astonishing operational efficiency, loading forty containers hourly.
examples.zh: 全自動化智慧貨櫃碼頭展現驚人的營運周轉效率，單部橋吊每小時能裝卸四十只貨櫃。

examples.en: Route optimization software streamlines delivery drops, boosting overall fleet fuel efficiency.
examples.zh: 智慧路徑最佳化導航系統精準串聯各配送節點，顯著提升了物流車隊整體的燃油能效與運轉率。

examples.en: Lean warehouse practices eliminate redundant walking, doubling package picking efficiency.
examples.zh: 導入精實倉儲動線管理徹底消除了倉管揀貨員多餘的無效走動，讓每天包裹揀貨裝箱效率足足翻倍。

words.definition: 串聯各大洋各大洲之緊密全球貿易連結

examples.en: Dense maritime shipping networks maintain unbroken economic connectivity across every continent.
examples.zh: 密集綿密的全球海運航線網絡，維繫著各大洋各大洲之間緊密不可分割的經濟貿易連結。

examples.en: Upgrading regional port infrastructure bolsters trade connectivity among developing island nations.
examples.zh: 全面擴建與升級區域深水商港基礎建設，能顯著帶動開發中海島國家之間的邊境貿易互聯互通。

examples.en: Reliable ocean freight routes provide the physical connectivity that sustains modern globalized industries.
examples.zh: 穩定可靠、風雨無阻的遠洋貨運定期航線，為現代全球化跨國分工體系構築起最強韌的實體貿易連結。

words.definition: 繁榮全球經濟命脈之海上貨運大動脈

examples.en: Maritime trade routes are the undisputed economic lifeline delivering everyday food, fuel, and technology.
examples.zh: 橫跨各大洋的海上貨運航線，是源源不絕為全人類輸送糧食、能源與關鍵科技產品的經濟命脈。

examples.en: Ferries and cargo boats are the only commercial lifeline delivering fresh food to remote offshore islands.
examples.zh: 往返穿梭的定期貨運渡輪與補給貨船，是為偏遠外島居民運送每日新鮮蔬果柴米油鹽的唯一生命線。

examples.en: Protecting deep-sea shipping lanes guarantees the continued survival of national energy lifelines.
examples.zh: 堅決守護國際深海航運要道暢通無阻，是確保國家戰略物資、天然氣與原油能源生命線不斷鏈的最高防線。

words.definition: 抵禦地緣政治斷鏈風險之超強供應鏈韌性

examples.en: Building agility and buffer inventories strengthens manufacturing supply chain resilience against crises.
examples.zh: 建立敏捷調度能力與適度安全庫存，能大幅增強現代製造業供應鏈的強大韌性。

examples.en: Port infrastructure designed with seismic resilience withstood the sudden coastal earthquake without damage.
examples.zh: 按照最高耐震標準設計施工的智慧港埠基建設施，在突如其來的沿海大地震中屹立不搖毫髮無損。

examples.en: Diversified multi-modal transport options give global logistics operations exceptional operational resilience.
examples.zh: 布局多元彈性的海陸空多式聯運備援路徑，賦予了跨國綜合物流體系極致卓越的危機應變韌性。

words.definition: 帶動全球實體經濟與人民生活繁榮富足

examples.en: Free, unimpeded oceanic commerce generates shared prosperity and raises living standards worldwide.
examples.zh: 自由通暢的全球海上航運與國際貿易，促進了全球實體經濟的共同繁榮並提升了各國人民的生活水準。

examples.en: The bustling container terminal fueled decades of industrial boom and regional economic prosperity.
examples.zh: 繁忙蓬勃運轉的國際貨櫃碼頭，點燃了沿海城市數十年間的工業騰飛與區域經濟繁榮。

examples.en: Efficient port cities attract international investment, generating good jobs and communal prosperity.
examples.zh: 營運高效的國際自由貿易港市能吸引源源不絕的跨國資本投資，為在地鄉親創造優渥就業與富足繁榮。

words.definition: 永不停歇跳動之世界海運貿易脈搏

examples.en: The rhythmic loading and unloading of container ships represents the steady heartbeat of modern commerce.
examples.zh: 港口日夜不息、規律吊裝貨櫃的壯麗景象，正是現代全球經濟貿易跳動不息的強勁脈搏。

examples.en: Night and day, the rumbling diesel engines and swinging crane booms echo like the industrial heartbeat of the harbor.
examples.zh: 不分晝夜，大馬力柴油引擎的低沉轟鳴與起重機吊臂在空中的靈動穿梭，如港區生生不息的工業心跳脈動。

examples.en: If maritime logistics ever stalls, the economic heartbeat of our modern global society slows to a crawl.
examples.zh: 一旦全球海事物流網絡發生任何停擺，現代全球化人類文明生氣勃勃的經濟脈搏將瞬間陷入停滯沉寂。
